title: signed_seconds_since_epoch: pre-epoch subsec millis wrong sign
description: crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs signed_seconds_since_epoch returns (-(d.as_secs()), d.subsec_millis()) for a pre-epoch clock. A clock 1.2 s before the epoch is instant -1.2 s = 1969-12-31T23:59:58.800Z, but the pair (-1, 200) formats as 23:59:59.200Z (and 0.5 s before epoch formats as 1970-01-01T00:00:00.500Z). Fix: when subsec is non-zero, return (-(s+1), 1000 - millis) with a rounding rule chosen deliberately. Found during JMAP-yt1w.40; out of scope there.
